senses.gloss: f. (denom. of מִדְבָּר) belonging to the desert.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 83a:18">Erub. 83ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>סאה מ׳</he> the S’ah of the Israelites in the desert, containing six desert Kab, or five Jerusalem Kab.—Pl. <he>מִדְבָּרִיִּים</he>, <he>מִדְבָּרִיִּין</he>; <he>מִדְבָּרִיּוֹת</he>.
Men. VII, 1, a. e., v. סְאָה.—Esp. מדבריות pasture-animals.
<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 5:7">Bets. V, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Beitzah 40a:14">40ᵃ</cite>), opp. <cite ref="B00608"><he>בַּיָּיתוֹת</he></cite>; Tosef. ib. IV, 11.
